messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up: monthly tokens & peak TPS

Hi Lisa — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and ask so we can size a hosted pricing proposal: 

1) Expected monthly token volume (total across prompts + responses): can you confirm a rough bucket (e.g., 10M / 50M / 100M / 500M)?
2) Peak TPS (requests per second) during burst windows — this affects our autoscaling and capacity planning.
3) Target unit economics: what is your target $ / 1M tokens (or target monthly budget range)?

From the call I captured that you want to support a user-facing chat product (ML assistant) with some batch embedding/analysis jobs at night. If you can confirm the bullets above, we’ll draft a hosted API price deck with a few commitment tiers and peak capacity options.

Attachments: I’ve attached our standard hosted pricing overview for context.

Next steps: if you can reply with those numbers today/tomorrow, Marissa will put together a preliminary estimate and I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through tradeoffs (cost vs latency vs fallbacks).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference

Ben — thanks for the quick recap. Confirming the numbers we discussed: 

- Expected monthly token volume: ~120,000,000 tokens/month (this is an initial estimate; could be +/- 20% over next 6 months as adoption grows)
- Peak TPS: ~25 TPS for user interactive traffic (short bursts up to 40 TPS during peak launch events)
- Budget range: roughly $30k-$50k / month initially (we can consider scaling commitments after Q4)
- Target unit economics: aiming for ~ $250 / 1M tokens (that’s our internal target for hosted LLM costs to make the product unit economics work)

We’re also interested in any committed/annual discount tiers and how peak smoothing / burst protections work. Tom (cc’d) is our infra lead — he may have more details on traffic shaping and SLOs.

Appreciate the follow-up — if you can send the preliminary estimate and a couple of modeled scenarios (no-commit, 3mo commit, 12mo commit) that would be great.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up: monthly tokens & peak TPS

Thanks Ben — and hi Lisa, great to see the numbers. Quick response from pricing/solutions: 

Summary (based on 120M tokens/mo and peak 25 TPS):
- No-commit (on-demand hosted): list price estimate = $420 / 1M tokens -> est monthly = $50,400 
- 3mo commit: ~15% discount -> $357 / 1M tokens -> est monthly = $42,840 
- 12mo commit: ~40% discount -> $252 / 1M tokens -> est monthly = $30,240 

Notes: the 12mo committed scenario is the closest to your target $250 / 1M tokens. Committed pricing also includes burst smoothing credits (we allocate reserve capacity for predictable bursts; short burst consumption above commit is billed at a reduced overage rate vs on-demand).

Peak TPS planning: with 25 TPS sustained (40 TPS bursts), we recommend a reserved pool sized to cover 30 TPS sustained for consistent latency with autoscale headroom for short spikes. We’ll show two routing options on the next deck: 
- Cost-first: route lower-precision or quantized variants during high-concurrency windows to reduce cost
- Latency-first: maintain single-model low-latency path and enable burst credits for traffic surges

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ben to schedule a 30-min follow-up with Acme (include Tom) — I’ll present the rate card and commit tiers.
2) If Acme is open, share a 30-day sample of real traffic to validate peak distribution and any long-tail (Marissa to request a small API key + ingestion test plan).
3) If they want legal terms/DocuSign, I’ll loop in Legal for standard hosted contract + SLA.

I’m attaching a quick rate-card PDF and a short slide with the modeled monthly costs. Ben — will you confirm availability for Wed/Thu this week?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Solutions & Pricing | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0202
